images.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Ezra the Jewish scribe and a small assembly of modestly robed travelers kneel in prayer and fasting beside the river Ahava at their ancient camp before their journey. Children and pack animals remain safely in the background. Solemn dependence on God, no soldiers or cavalry escort, no meals laid out, ancient tents and water.

Ezra and two Jewish priestly leaders in a Persian-period camp carefully weigh silver and gold using an ancient beam balance and stone weights on a wooden table. Sealed bags and a few gold bowls beside them, a scribe records the weight on a scroll with illegible marks. Accurate hands, two arms each, no modern scales, no invented visible numbers.
images.edit_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this historical biblical weighing scene only to remove ALL background soldiers, guards, helmets, spears and weapons. Keep the three foreground men, their faces, exactly two arms each, hands, beam balance, precious metal, bowls, table, tents, river, light and composition otherwise unchanged. No readable text, blood or modern objects.

rows: Wie wil mag meetrekken; goud, zilver en gerei voor Jeruzalem.

Op de vierde dag in Jeruzalem naar aantal en gewicht overgedragen en opgeschreven.
